name: Alsace Onion Flan
instructions: Melt the butter in a large lidded frying pan , add the onions and bay leaf , season with salt and pepper
Cover the onions closely with a piece of buttered greaseproof paper then put the lid on the frying pan
Cook the onions over a low heat for about 30 minutes until they are soft and golden
Roll the pastry to inch thick on a lightly floured surface and use it to line an 8-9 inch diameter flan dish
Beat the eggs lightly in a large bowl and season with salt , pepper and nutmeg
Stir the cream and milk into the beaten egg mixture
Drain the coked onions in a colander , remove the bay leaf and spread the onions over the pastry case
Strain the egg mixture through a sieve over the onions
Bake the flan in the centre of an oven pre-heated to 400f / 200c / gas mark 6 for 35 40 minutes: when cooked the pastry should be golden and the filling set
The filling will sink slightly as the flan cools
